source_title: Here’s everything new in Android 17 QPR3 Beta 3 [Gallery]
source_excerpt:
Google today rolled out a big Android 17 QPR3 Beta 3 with a number of fixes for Pixel devices.
Over the coming hours, we’ll dive into all of Android 17 QPR3 Beta 3’s new features and every single change. (The newest updates will be at the top of this list. Be sure to check back often and tell us what you find in the comments below.) Android 17 QPR3 Beta 2 screenshots appear on the left and Android 17 QPR3 Beta 3 on the right.
If you want to quickly install Android 17 QPR3 Beta 3 on your compatible Pixel 6a, Pixel 7, Pixel 7 Pro, Pixel 7a, Pixel Tablet, Pixel Fold, Pixel 8, Pixel 8 Pro, Pixel 8a, Pixel 9, Pixel 9 Pro, Pixel 9 Pro XL, Pixel 9 Pro Fold, Pixel 9a, Pixel 10, Pixel 10 Pro, Pixel 10 Pro XL, Pixel 10 Pro Fold, Pixel 10a, Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, Pixel 11 Pro XL, and Pixel 11 Pro Fold be sure to check out our step-by-step guide .
Captures full screen, including status and navigation bars

Display rendering issue when adjusting the font size slider in Settings. ( Issue #554687371 )

Device crashes intermittently on the lock screen or shortly after startup. ( Issue #569613685 )
Apps crash when BluetoothLeScanner.stopScan() is called with a null callback. ( Issue #571626896 )
WPA-Enterprise Wi-Fi connections fail when authenticating with PEAP. ( Issue #572438311 , Issue #569431116 , Issue #565959472 )
